about:
AAW Auto Parts has operated from Pasco, Washington since 1996. The family‑owned and operated business was established to serve the automotive aftermarket across South Eastern Washington, and it remains under family stewardship today.

The company functions as a wholesale and retail distributor, stocking more than 550,000 auto parts and accessories for domestic and foreign vehicles in a 15,000‑square‑foot facility. In addition to traditional counter and jobber sales, AAW offers delivery to commercial accounts, a retail walk‑in counter, and a specialized ECU reprogramming service covering OBD‑II General Motors and Chrysler control modules. Staff experience is emphasized: counter personnel average more than 15 years in the industry, and the leadership team includes CEO/Sales Director Bill Astley, Sales Manager Don Webb, and driver/Ebay specialist Wanita Harris.

Customers range from independent repair shops and fleet operators buying at wholesale to DIY consumers purchasing at retail. The catalog draws on relationships with established aftermarket brands — many with 20 to 50 years of manufacturing history — as well as newer suppliers vetted before inclusion. Manufacturers ship direct from warehouses nationwide, a model AAW says reduces markup and accelerates delivery.

The firm cites its family structure as a cost advantage, avoiding corporate overhead and passing savings to buyers. Its stated mission is to deliver the correct part on the first attempt, backed by overnight shipping on most stock orders and a commitment to long‑term customer retention.
